name: Mecca & Jeddah
description: Combined map of Mecca, Islam's holiest city, and Jeddah, its Red Sea gateway, connected by the Haramain corridor. 528,000+ OSM buildings, 2022 Saudi census population data, King Abdulaziz International Airport, Masjid al-Haram, King Abdulaziz University, Umm Al-Qura University, simulated traffic.
